name: watersplash-imagemasking

frames.best_why: The splash silhouette, droplets and mountain photo are all fully visible and centred.

tagline: Mountain landscape seen through a water-splash cut-out with droplets.
summary: A single photo of snow-capped mountains and clouds masked into an irregular splash shape, with scattered round droplets floating around it on black.
appearance: One wide landscape photo of pale mountains under a cloudy sky fills a large, irregular splash-shaped mask with soft, rounded edges. Several circular droplets of the same image float nearby at different sizes, all on a black stage.
use_when: A campaign or article wants a single hero image with an unusual liquid-shaped crop.
avoid_when: The splash mask is loaded from /splash.svg, and the image is fixed to one Unsplash URL.
customise: The photo URL and the /splash.svg mask are hardcoded; changing the picture or splash outline needs a source and asset edit. No props.
weight_why: One CSS-masked image, no animation or script.

a11y.note: The image has empty alt text, so the landscape is not described, and there is no caption or role for the masked artwork.

issues: The image has empty alt text.
The mask depends on /splash.svg being present, otherwise the photo shows as a plain rectangle.
polish_why: Clean liquid crop and a striking photo; it is a single static image with no description or motion.
